questions.stemEn: A child presents with cough and loss of smell and taste. His father has similar symptoms. How will you diagnose him?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار nasopharyngeal PCR ويشرح أن NAAT/RT-PCR يُجرى على عينات تنفسية مثل nasopharyngeal أو nasal specimens، بينما viral culture لا يُستخدم كاختبار سريري روتيني في هذا السياق.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies NAAT/RT-PCR from respiratory specimens as the diagnostic approach and states that viral culture is mainly reserved for research.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Nasopharyngeal culture ليس الاختبار التشخيصي الروتيني الذي يختاره المصدر لـCOVID-19.
questions.clinicalPearl: The source tests respiratory NAAT/PCR rather than viral culture for COVID-19 diagnosis.
diagnosticSteps: Obtain an appropriate respiratory specimen for NAAT/PCR

questions.stemEn: A child presents with cough and loss of smell and taste in a COVID-19 case. What is the recommended isolation in the source question?

options.text: Droplet isolation in a neutral room
Droplet isolation in a negative-pressure room

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار droplet isolation in a neutral room، ويذكر أن Standard + Contact + Droplet precautions كانت التوصية العامة في البروتوكول الذي استند إليه السؤال، بينما Airborne precautions تُستخدم أثناء aerosol-generating procedures.
questions.reasoningEn: The source's MOH COVID-19 guidance differentiates general contact/droplet precautions from airborne precautions for aerosol-generating procedures.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر لا يطلب negative-pressure room للحالة الروتينية، ويخصص airborne precautions للإجراءات المولدة للرذاذ الهوائي.
questions.clinicalPearl: This is a historical protocol-based exam item; infection-control guidance should be rechecked before publication.

questions.stemEn: A mother who has just been diagnosed with COVID-19 asks for advice regarding breastfeeding. What will you tell her?

options.text: Breast milk expression is not allowed
Isolate the baby immediately and give expressed milk
It is okay to breastfeed while applying infection-control strategies

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار الاستمرار في breastfeeding مع تطبيق infection-control precautions، ويذكر أن AAP يدعم الرضاعة الطبيعية للأم المصابة بـCOVID-19 مع الاحتياطات المناسبة.
questions.reasoningEn: The source states that AAP supports breastfeeding in mothers with COVID-19 with appropriate infection-control precautions.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر لا يوصي بإيقاف breastfeeding أو منع expressed milk كقاعدة عامة، ولا يختار الفصل الفوري كإجابة في هذا السؤال.
questions.clinicalPearl: The source supports breastfeeding with appropriate precautions.
managementSteps: Continue breastfeeding while following the infection-control measures specified by current guidance

questions.stemEn: A child is admitted with pneumonia requiring respiratory support, and PCR is positive for COVID-19. What CT finding is expected in the source question?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار ground-glass opacities ويذكر أن CT في الأطفال المصابين بـCOVID-19 قد يكون طبيعيًا، لكن من أكثر abnormalities المذكورة ground-glass opacities ثم consolidation/pneumonic infiltrates.
questions.reasoningEn: The source explanation identifies ground-glass opacities as the most common CT abnormality among the listed findings.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Consolidation يمكن أن تظهر حسب المصدر لكنها أقل شيوعًا من ground-glass opacities في البيانات التي استشهد بها. Pleural effusion ليست النمط الذي اختاره المصدر.
questions.clinicalPearl: The source notes that pediatric CT can be normal; when abnormal, ground-glass opacities are common.

questions.stemEn: A child recently diagnosed with COVID-19 presents with shortness of breath, fever of 38.6 degrees Celsius, and oxygen saturation of 88% on room air. What will you give next?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار dexamethasone ويستند إلى MOH COVID-19 Protocol الذي ذكر systemic corticosteroids للمرضى الذين يحتاجون supplemental oxygen. هذا سؤال علاجي زمني لذلك لا يُنقل إلى verified بدون مراجعة التوصيات الحالية.
questions.reasoningEn: The source protocol recommends systemic corticosteroids for patients requiring supplemental oxygen and therefore keys dexamethasone.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر لا يختار eculizumab أو oseltamivir أو cefuroxime كالعلاج المقصود لهذا hypoxemic COVID-19 scenario.
questions.clinicalPearl: Historical COVID-19 treatment item; current recommendations must be checked before publication.
managementSteps: Provide respiratory support as clinically required
Use treatment according to current COVID-19 guidance after verification

questions.stemEn: A child recently diagnosed with COVID-19 presents to the emergency department with cough, shortness of breath, fever of 38.6 degrees Celsius, respiratory distress, and oxygen saturation of 88% on room air. How will you manage this child?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار supportive management لأن dexamethasone لم يكن ضمن الخيارات في نسخة 2024، ويحيل إلى السؤال السابق الذي يتناول steroid عند الحاجة للأكسجين. لذلك نحفظ مفتاح الامتحان كما هو مع ملاحظة أن الصياغة treatment-era dependent.
questions.reasoningEn: The compilation explicitly notes that dexamethasone was not among the 2024 choices and keys supportive management, referring to the preceding treatment item.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر لا يدعم eculizumab أو oseltamivir أو cefuroxime كالإجابة لهذا السيناريو. لكنه أيضًا يوضح أن الخيارات ناقصة مقارنة بالسؤال السابق، لذلك يحتاج مراجعة قبل النشر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Preserve the exam key, but flag this item because the available choices omit a therapy mentioned in the preceding source question.

questions.stemEn: A child had COVID-19 two weeks ago and now meets laboratory criteria for MIS-C. Echocardiography shows coronary dilatation with an aneurysm. What will you do next?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار steroid + IVIG ويذكر ضمن MOH COVID-19 Protocol immunomodulation بـIVIG مع methylprednisolone، إضافةً إلى low-dose aspirin لجميع مرضى MIS-C وanticoagulation في حالات مختارة حسب الشدة وخطر thrombosis.
questions.reasoningEn: The source protocol lists IVIG with methylprednisolone as immunomodulatory therapy for MIS-C and discusses thromboprophylaxis.
questions.clinicalPearl: MIS-C management is guideline-sensitive; source treatment is preserved but must be rechecked before verified publication.
managementSteps: Source protocol also discusses low-dose aspirin and selected anticoagulation

questions.stemEn: A child presents with the skin rash shown as gloves-and-socks syndrome. What is the most likely causative organism?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يربط papular-purpuric gloves-and-socks syndrome بـParvovirus B19 ويختار الخيار B.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies the gloves-and-socks syndrome in this item as a parvovirus B19 manifestation.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Coxsackievirus A16 يرتبط بصورة أخرى من viral exanthem، وGroup A Streptococcus ليس المسبب الذي اختبره المصدر لهذا الشكل من الطفح.
questions.clinicalPearl: Papular-purpuric gloves-and-socks syndrome is a classic parvovirus B19 clue in the source.
